name: Fathom
install: set -e; if ! command -v pdftoppm >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! python3 -c 'import ensurepip' >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq python3-venv poppler-utils; fi; [ -x .venv/bin/python ] || python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/python -m pip install -q --upgrade pip; .venv/bin/python -m pip install -q -e '.[dev,serve]'; [ -d "$HOME/.fathom/projects/campus" ] || .venv/bin/fathom new campus --template campus-demo

terminals.name: Fathom server
terminals.description: Fathom dev server at http://localhost:8080 (no login; data in ~/.fathom with the campus-demo sample project). Restart this terminal after Python changes; static JS/CSS changes need only a browser reload.
